detail.body:
# Description

With #3137, C++ operator tests will run in sequential and it gets a lot faster than previously because previously they run in parallel which incurs lots of overhead for launching & cleaning up. Now, even if we enable all activations, they won't take that much time to run

|  | With all activations enabled | Only enable  GeLU |
|---|---:|---:|
| Full C++ suite | 23m 9.12s | **15m 5.80s** |
| MXFP8 test groups | 123\.82s | **54\.42s** |

(Before #3137 this takes around an hour so I'd say this is acceptable for us)

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [x] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

Please list the changes introduced in this PR:

- Enable all activations

# Checklist:

- [ ] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [ ] The functionality is complete
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Low risk]** Enables more activation types in C\+\+ unit tests\. The PR appears safe to merge; no outstanding finding or new actionable defect was identified.

Summary

The PR enables SiLU, ReLU, QGeLU, and SReLU in the MXFP8 C++ activation test matrices. It also extends grouped multichunk dBias/dActivation coverage to those activations.
